crossRefs.note: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

translations.web: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see Him, but they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd.
translations.kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
translations.asv: And there came to him his mother and brethren, and they could not come at him for the crowd.
